name: smwpatches-h-none-bg-scroll-reset-patch-v1
title: H:None BG Scroll Reset Patch v1.2
description:
fixes the glitch in which the BG's X-position isn't reset when the player exits from a level with H:Variable into a level with H:None

Do not use this with LM 3.0. LM already fixes this.


v1.2:
----------------
Cleaner code. Better usage of 16bit A.

v1.1:
----------------
Fixed a bug where this patch wouldn't consider the fact that AXY were in 16bit mode.
Converted to asar format.
